Execution order: Markdown step 10 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 33 (Markdown 09/12 — Reuse the existing editable Markdown panel with guarded drafts). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Update the real shared agent workflow so official narrative design is authored through Adashi and naturally discovered from files.
Scope:
- Change agents_template.md Formal design, generated content and search sections to include first-class Markdown alongside C4/UML/mockups, standalone project scope and task/QA specification references.
- Explicitly direct agents to create/update design prose through adashi_design, not ad hoc docs files or project memory. Agents may read generated full Markdown; they must retrieve fresh canonical content/readTokens before writes and use help for current operation schemas.
- Include valid create/update/retrieve examples for the implemented API, stale-token merge guidance and stable-ID navigation. Clarify that MCP-only authoring applies to agents; humans can edit through the desktop. Exported headers/revisions are not write tokens.
- Trace and update template distribution/copy/injection paths and relevant MCP help/user docs so both new projects and existing configured workflows receive consistent guidance while preserving user-authored/custom instruction text.
- Extend lifecycle startup discovery with bounded Markdown metadata/retrieval pointers, not full bodies or duplicated API manuals. Preserve all lifecycle hooks and existing custom rules.
Acceptance:
- Published examples execute against actual schemas; fixture tests demonstrate discovery from root/folder shorts and complete files followed by correct canonical read/save.
- No generated message tells agents to edit exported files or treats a prose artefact as an instruction overriding user intent.
- Check new/existing project guidance and custom text preservation. The source template change is part of this implementation task, not merely a note in task descriptions.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications. The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.
